# hallpass_destination_collector (Resource)

Enrolls a destination audit collector (`hallpass-collector`) on one server: its Ed25519 public key signs the batches of process and file records it sends. Its records can attach to every session on that server. Destroying the resource revokes the key; a changed key (for example after reinstalling the collector) enrolls the new key and revokes the old one. HallPass keeps the names of revoked collectors reserved on their server, so leave `name` unset (it is then derived from the key) or change it together with the key. Import with the collector ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The key printed by `hallpass-collector pubkey` on web1.
resource "hallpass_destination_collector" "web1" {
  server_id  = hallpass_server.web1.id
  public_key = "ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIGq7cO0yVdHqfEyA3BqU0sNbB9p8l3zTt0hZfMq4kVqJ web1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `public_key` (String) The collector's `ssh-ed25519` public key, as `hallpass-collector pubkey` prints it. Changing it forces a new enrollment.
- `server_id` (String) Server ID (`srv_…`). Changing it forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name shown in the console (at most 64 characters, unique per server including revoked collectors). Defaults to `collector-` and the first 12 hex digits of the key's SHA-256. Changing it forces a new enrollment.

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint of the key.
- `id` (String) Collector ID (`dac_…`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Collector ID
terraform import hallpass_destination_collector.web1 dac_01m5qh1t09e4jbmeys0q0bjz8j
```
